messages.author: 39f5a1aeeec9eadd
messages.subject: datetime-input
parts:
Hi. Thanks again for shiny - it is a fantastic piece of work.

I did not find much in the way of how to handle datetime inputs on the serverside


ui.R  # less the fat

HTML(paste0('<input type="datetime-local" name="time" id="time" value="', Sys.Date(), 'T', substring(Sys.time(), 12, 16), '"><br>'))


server.R  # less the fat

print(input$time)  # NULL


I'm just not sure why input$time is returning NULL - is there something about input and datetime that hasn't been developed yet. Any info will be appreciated.

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: datetime-input
parts:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/290?source=cc

For Shiny to pick up these components, someone needs to define them. The above issue suggests that it's not been done and no one is doing it yet. 

If you like you can try to write your code to implement it by following the tutorial 

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#building-inputs
